rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or their work when it is organized and methodical.

example.english: They are very methodical in their work, and their files are clearly sorted.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好有條理，文件分類得好清楚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5 man4 gin2 fan1 leoi6 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a plan, approach, or process follows a coherent system.

example.english: This study method is very methodical, so it does not leave out any lesson.
example.traditional: 呢套溫習方法好有系統，唔會漏咗任何一課。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 wan1 zaap6 fong1 faat3 hou2 jau5 hai6 tung2 m4 wui6 lau6 zo2 jam6 ho4 jat1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when someone proceeds methodically by following one step after another.

example.english: We were methodical and followed each step, so we should finish soon.
example.traditional: 我哋按部就班咁做，應該好快就完成。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 on3 bou6 zau6 baan1 gam3 zou6 jing1 goi1 hou2 faai3 zau6 jyun4 sing4
